title: The presentation of Certificate No. 186-38 (LS) - Relative to recognizing Senior Citizens Month and celebrating the invaluable contributions, wisdom, resilience, and enduring legacy of our island’s beloved manåmko’. In observance of this year’s theme, “Champion Your Health 2026,” this special presentation also highlights the importance of promoting health, wellness, active living, and quality of life for Guam’s senior citizens while honoring their lifelong contributions to our community.
